question: Rank 10 km equal-area cells in Washington by whether at least one wildfire discovery is recorded in FPA FOD on the target day.
framing: Retrospective association study. Weather comes from a reanalysis that was not available in real time, so results support no early-warning claim.

grid.keep: cell centroid inside the state boundary

outcome.positive: reported-discovery: at least one FPA FOD record whose DISCOVERY_DOY in FIRE_YEAR is the target date and whose point falls in the cell
outcome.negative: no-record-in-reviewed-scope: an eligible cell-day with no such record. This is a database outcome, not proof that no fire occurred.
outcome.unknown: records without a usable date or location are excluded and counted

reference_dataset: FPA FOD 7th edition (FPA_FOD_20260615), US Forest Service EDW_FireOccurrenceCurrentEdition_01 layer 0
date_convention: Target dates are FPA FOD local discovery days. FIRMS acquisitions are converted to America/Los_Angeles dates. Every feature for target day D uses data dated D-1 or earlier.

spatial_holdout.name: northeast Washington
spatial_holdout.rule: cell centroid east of -118.6 and north of 47.9 degrees

decision_gate: Unset. The product owner and a qualified domain reviewer must set numeric thresholds before any model can be promoted. Results stay offline research.
